warnings: decoded values are raw register/wire contents from static JTAG samples; this tool does not decide a root cause and cannot prove a deadlock
values flagged *_meaningful == false (x_valid == 0) are raw idle-channel wire levels and must not be read as a transaction
blocked_valid_not_ready entries can be ordinary transient AXI backpressure; a single snapshot is not a stall verdict

samples.blocked_flags_note: each entry is a static valid && !ready observation of one sample instant; ordinary transient AXI backpressure also shows valid && !ready, so this listing is not by itself evidence of a stall or of a deadlock

cross_sample.method: deltas are computed only between neighbouring samples that are both 'trusted' and whose 20-bit sequence field is contiguous (next == prev + 1 mod 2^20)

pairs.note: modulo differences only: cycle_q mod 2^32 and 16-bit counters mod 2^16; this pair does not prove that nothing wrapped and does not give an absolute backlog
modulo differences only: cycle_q mod 2^32 and 16-bit counters mod 2^16; this pair does not prove that nothing wrapped and does not give an absolute backlog

notes: differencing two samples yields only a modulo difference: cycle_q is mod 2^32, the four 16-bit counters are mod 2^16; a wrap inside the interval is indistinguishable from the reported value, so these numbers are not absolute elapsed cycles or absolute outstanding counts
no cross-sample conclusion is drawn for a pair when a sample is not trusted or when the sequence is not contiguous
